jog_up.action: light jog moving AWAY from the viewer, seen from BEHIND, 8-frame run cycle. STRICT left/right alternation measured by position on screen: in frames 1,2,3,4 the leg on the LEFT SIDE OF THE IMAGE is kicked up behind with its flip-flop sole visible while the leg on the RIGHT side of the image is straight on the ground; in frames 5,6,7,8 it is mirrored: the leg on the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE is kicked up with sole visible while the LEFT side leg is straight on the ground. Frame 2 and frame 6 have the highest kick, frames 4 and 8 are airborne. Arms bent and swinging opposite to the legs. The bag stays on the same side of the body in all frames.

style: ink linework with muted watercolor, realistic proportions, same as the base image
